kelleher_nan.text: Come in, come in, mind the cat. Sit down and I will put the kettle on. It is a very Cork thing to do, and a very everyone thing.
A word for you: 'gatch' means a swagger, or a daft way of walking. Your gatch is lovely, by the way.
If something is squealing by the bins at night, that is a Binfox. Foxes see in the dark with cat-like pupils, so a torch is no use for sneaking.
